name: cowork30-monorepo
description: Coworking Space Management Platform - Dual deployment in single Render service

scripts.build: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node prisma/seed.js && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm install --force && npm run build
scripts.start: npx concurrently -k "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
